full_name: Narges Mahyar | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Narges Mahyar is an assistant professor at the Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences, University of Massachusetts Amherst, whose research is situated at the intersection of human-computer interaction, information visualization, social computing, applied machine learning, human-centered artificial intelligence, and design.
